name: Parity Cooling Tower — Sheet → Analyze → Emailed Report

nodes.name: Read addresses
nodes.notes: Reads every row. Required column: Address. Optional: Boro_Area, Zip.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [ { parts: [ { text: "You normalize US building addresses for geocoding. Output ONLY one clean line as `number street, city, STATE ZIP` with no commentary, no quotes. Input: " + ([$json.Address, $json.Boro_Area, $json.Zip].filter(Boolean).join(', ')) } ] } ] } }}

nodes.name: Normalize (optional)
nodes.notes: DISABLED by default → rows pass through unchanged. Enable to clean messy address formats with Gemini before geocoding. 'Build address' reads both this node's output and the raw row, so enabling/disabling needs no other change.

nodes.name: Analyze
nodes.notes: Runs once per address (n8n executes HTTP per input item). Retries transient failures; a permanently failing address still flows through (alwaysOutputData) so the batch never aborts.

nodes.name: Build report
nodes.notes: Returns the self-contained HTML report as text (in $json.data).

nodes.name: Send report
nodes.notes: Inlines the HTML report. Add the same HTML as a .html attachment via Options → Attachments if you prefer.
